// CASE js_seq_nobrace expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) await step(item), await save(item);
}
// CASE js_dynamic_import expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		consume(await step(item), await import(`./plugins/${item}.js`));
	}
}
// CASE js_import_arg expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		consume(await step(item), import(await path(item)));
	}
}
// CASE js_array_spread_distinct expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		consume(await step(item), [...(await save(item))]);
	}
}
// CASE js_default_destructure expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		const { a = await save(item) } = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_assignment_target expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		cache[await key(item)] = await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_comma_paren expect=fire
async function inOrder(items, step, { reason }) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await save(item), await step(item);
	}
}
// CASE js_steps_member_distinct expect=fire
async function inOrderSteps(steps, { reason }) {
	for (const step of steps) {
		(await step()).merge(await audit());
	}
}
// CASE js_worker_index_await expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[await slot(index)] = await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
// CASE js_worker_receiver_await expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				(await store()).put(await operation(items[index]));
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
